description: Change a Plumbline order draft the way the buyer asked: add, update, remove or replace companies (name an item by its key from the draft, or by match on its name), or clear the list (item fields: name (the company's name as the buyer has it, or its exact legal name); country (ISO 3166 two-letter code; narrows the LEI search by name); lei (20-character Legal Entity Identifier; the report then reads that exact record); cik (SEC Central Index Key; adds the SEC EDGAR registration (EDGAR is not searched by name))). The app in the conversation shows the change at once. A placed order is never changed (the draft is locked); a change after the request was sent is a revision the buyer sends again with send_order_draft. Repeat a call with the same op_id and it is applied once.

from_app.description: Set only by the app itself

op_id.description: Your id for this change, so a retry is applied once

field.description: Or one field by name, with value

values.description: Single fields of the order by name; an empty value clears one

token.description: The draft's private token (also the receipt token of every request sent from it); keep it private

name: update_order_draft
title: Change the order draft
